issues.description: `sys` is referenced in cpython/mathimpl.py and np/math/mathimpl.py without an `import sys` in either file.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The diff adds `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` to both impl files but only adds `import sys` to mathdecl.py. If `sys` isn't already imported at the top of these modules, this is a NameError at import time on every Python version. Verify and add the import.

issues.description: Version-gate block in mathdecl.py has suspicious indentation/placement around the Math_unary class boundary.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged the `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11):` block placed immediately after the class with no blank line. Torvalds additionally notes the `Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` pattern rebinds the class name rather than being a bare decorator-call statement. Restore PEP 8 spacing, ensure the class body has ended, and avoid rebinding the class name.

issues.description: Inconsistent version-gate idioms: production code uses `sys.version_info`, tests use `PYVERSION`.
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The codebase already exposes `numba.core.utils.PYVERSION` as the canonical predicate. Using raw `sys.version_info` in three production files and `PYVERSION` in tests creates two sources of truth. Standardize on `PYVERSION` everywhere for maintainability across future version bumps.

issues.description: Test inputs are thin, copy-pasted from test_exp, and miss exp2's interesting edge cases.
issues.detail: Knuth and Torvalds flagged this. `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is reused verbatim from test_exp (with a duplicated `-2`), covers no exact integer powers, no overflow near 1024, no 0, inf, or nan, and no explicit parity check against CPython `math.exp2`. Add meaningful edge cases and state the input domain per type.

issues.description: Release note file `10276.new_feature.rst` is missing a trailing newline (and underline length is wrong).
issues.detail: All three reviewers flagged this. The file ends with `\ No newline at end of file`, and Torvalds notes the RST underline length doesn't match the title, which some toolchains will warn or error on. Add the trailing newline and fix the underline.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the feature shape is right — registering `math.exp2` via the existing `llvm.exp2` intrinsic pattern is correctly substitutable for `math.exp` — but execution needs another pass before merge. Two P0s block landing: `sys` is used in two impl files without a visible `import sys`, and the version-gate block in `mathdecl.py` has suspicious placement around the Math_unary class boundary (Torvalds additionally flags class-name rebinding). Beyond that, the patch invents two ways to spell the 3.11 check when `PYVERSION` already exists, the release note is missing a trailing newline, and the tests look copy-pasted from `test_exp` with no edge cases. NEEDS-WORK.
